newsitem.title: USA: American Rivers, Opon deal off.
newsitem.headline: American Rivers, Opon deal off.

text.p: American Rivers Oil Co said on Friday after about 10 months of merger negotiations with OPON Development Co that OPON had decided not to pursue the deal as previously structured.

American Rivers said a letter of intent it had signed with OPON last year had expired but it continued to explore the possibility of a business combination involving OPON interests under new terms and conditions.
OPON owns a working interest in a gas field in Colombia, South America operated by Amoco Corp.

American Rivers and OPON had planned to merge into a new company which would acquire all outstanding American Rivers and OPON shares. Upon completion of the deal, OPON would have owned 90 percent to 95 percent of the new company and OPON management would operate the company.
The company, in a press release, also said it expected the distribution from a previously announced spin-off of its Bishop Capital Corp to be completed during the second quarter.
The transaction was a partial liquidating distribution to the holders of the company's common stock, it said.
